title: Piano Path
subtitle: From intermediate to ABRSM Grade 7, pop and classical; a check-in turns what you already play into quick reviews.
benchmark: ABRSM piano Grade 7, Pianote Method level 9

levels.title: Check-in
levels.goal: Find what is already solid. Nothing is skipped: a passed check turns its steps into quick reviews, one cold Check run each on two days.
levels.adds: Scales: check at G3 and G4. Pop: check a chord chart. Reading: check Level 3.

steps.title: Scales at Grade 3 speed
steps.setup: Scales: C, G, D and F major, A, D and E harmonic minor; hands together, two octaves, up and down, Grade 3 (crotchet 80, two a click).
steps.done: 6 of the 7 keys clean within two tries.

steps.title: Scales at Grade 4 speed
steps.setup: The same keys at Grade 4 (crotchet 100), adding Bb and Eb major, B and C minor.
steps.done: 6 of 8 keys clean.

steps.title: Arpeggios
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio: C, G, F, A minor, D minor; hands together, two octaves, Grade 3.
steps.done: 4 of 5 clean.

steps.title: Reading
steps.setup: Reading, sight-reading Level 3 as a climb: treble, then bass.
steps.done: 80% at Level 3 in both clefs.

steps.title: Cadences
steps.setup: Voicings, cadences I IV I V7 I, in 4 keys.
steps.done: 20 chords at 85% or better.

steps.title: Chord chart
steps.setup: Play I-V-vi-IV in C at 80 in Jam: RH triads in closest position, LH root, as a self-check. Judged on Voicings, closest chords, until the pattern drill exists (Jam runs are practice).
steps.done: Two choruses without a stop or a wrong chord.

steps.title: Piece test
steps.setup: Song Studio, performance mode, after one week of learning each: Minuet in G minor (Grade 2), Clementi Op. 36 No. 1 first movement (Grade 3), Burgmüller Ballade Op. 100 No. 15 (Grade 4). The scores are on the L1 and L3 shelves.
steps.done: 90% at 100% tempo. A passed piece counts on its shelf; the path still runs from L1.

levels.test: Every level stays in the path. A step marked review needs one clean Check run, cold, on two different days; a review that fails turns back into a normal step.

levels.title: Chords from a chart
levels.goal: play any I-V-vi-IV song from a chord chart with a LH bass and RH triads; Grade 3 scales and arpeggios in 13 keys; reading Level 3 in both clefs.
levels.adds: Scales: G3 in 13 keys. Pop: block chords, LH root-fifth-octave. Reading: Level 3 both clefs.

steps.title: Major scales at Grade 3
steps.setup: Scales: C, G, D, A, F, Bb, Eb major; hands together, two octaves, up and down, Grade 3.
steps.done: Each key 3 clean runs, on two days.

steps.title: Minor scales at Grade 3
steps.setup: Scales: A, E, D, G, B, C minor, harmonic and melodic; same setup. Judged on harmonic minor; melodic by the link.
steps.done: Each key 3 clean runs, on two days.
steps.feeds: Minuet in G minor, Old French Song

steps.title: Arpeggios at Grade 3
steps.setup: Scales, arpeggio: the 13 keys of 1.1 and 1.2, Grade 3 (crotchet 72). Pick each key in the drill.
steps.done: 3 clean runs per key, on two days.

steps.title: Contrary motion and chromatic
steps.setup: Two hands, contrary-motion scale in C. E major and the chromatic scale from D wait for new Scales options (drill 4).

steps.title: Triads through their inversions, 12 keys

steps.done: All 12 keys at 90% or better.
steps.feeds: every pop song on the shelf

steps.title: Closest-position chords from a chart
steps.setup: Voicings, closest chords, in C, G, D and F. The drill plays I IV V I; I-V-vi-IV and the top-voice limit wait for the pattern drill.
steps.done: 48 chords at 90%, top voice moving 4 semitones or less per change.

steps.title: Patterns 1 and 2: block chords with a LH root
steps.setup: Phrases: I vi IV V, then Jam pop-axis at 80. The pop pattern drill (drill 1) will add the keys.
steps.done: Two clean choruses in C, G and F at 80.

steps.title: Pattern 3: LH root-fifth-octave
steps.setup: Accompaniment, pattern 3 (root, fifth, octave) under I-V-vi-IV, in C, then G.
steps.done: Two clean choruses in C and G at 72.

steps.title: Sight-reading, Level 3, both clefs
steps.setup: Reading, sight-reading Level 3 as a climb: treble, then bass.
steps.done: 80% at Level 3 in each clef, on three days.

steps.title: Off-beat rhythm

steps.done: 5 runs at 80% or better.

steps.done: 2 songs pass: 90% at 100% tempo in performance mode, on two days.
